Dedicated to Christian Wisdom. Pagan statues kept as art. Constantine invited senators, proprietors, officials, artisans, merchants. Free corn distribution transferred from Rome/Egypt.    - *Post-Theodosius/Alaric/Gainas/Chrysostom (pp. 70-79):* Theodosius died 395. Arcadius (East) and Honorius (West). Gothic leaders Gainas, Alaric, Stilicho. Justinian hardworking, suspicious, great legal works, compared to Louis XIV. Empire prosperous on accession. Army 150,000-200,000, heavy cavalry favored. Financial system oppressive.
